desc:
🎁 Join the Axefall community to claim a free in-game gift!

🪓 Chop trees and gather resources
💰 Complete customer orders to earn coins
🏠 Upgrade your base and expand your factory
⚔️ Explore forests and dungeons, defeat bosses, and collect rare loot
🧭 Rescue survivors and trade with them for valuable loot
🏹 Defend your base from raider attacks

⚙️ Playing on a low-end device? Enable Performance Mode in Settings for a smoother experience.
